verification_status: Native Fusion confirmed zero airwires, copper clearance errors and overlap errors; two matched-length errors and forty wire-stub warnings remain. Engineering draft.
technology: Four layers; filled and copper capped via-in-pad required; 0.2mm minimum drill, 0.125mm minimum via annulus; minimum trace 0.15mm; copper clearance 0.127mm. Engineering draft, not a fabrication release.
